methodology.categories: Exact reviewed primary attention styles. Local/sliding-window models may include global attention; linear hybrids may include full or sparse attention. Mamba remains separate.
methodology.context: Opaque source context labels; bucket/text ratios do not prove exact boundaries or a disjoint partition. Model context-window capacity is not measured request demand.
methodology.contributors: Top five individually observed September model/API variants per selected category in All text and 1M. Serving variants remain distinct and are counted once.
methodology.dates: Complete UTC calendar months; January has 31 days and September has 30. Growth uses mean daily tokens.
methodology.denominator: Each context dataset retains all reported tokens, including unresolved architectures and the unnamed top-50 tail.
methodology.measure: Reported prompt plus completion tokens, not requests, users, memory bytes or a controlled performance benchmark.
methodology.missingness: A category absent from named rankings is null, not zero usage. Incomplete months suppress totals, shares and growth. Explicit observed zero remains zero.
methodology.population: Public rankings exclude private/ZDR traffic. Shifts in model availability, pricing, free tiers and observed coverage can change shares.
methodology.unresolved: Architecture unresolved and attention-style unresolved remain separate. Their combined visibility metric excludes the unnamed tail, which is reported separately.
